calls.title: On3 Recruits + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The team aims to optimize subscription pricing through basic experimentation, primarily concentrating on changing price points linked to sports events. Although they currently use Recurly for subscription tracking, improvements are needed for better attribution of experiments to actual subscription outcomes. They are exploring enhanced targeting during events like March Madness, utilizing user attributes for more effective price testing. Additionally, the cumbersome manual feature flagging process necessitates a more user-friendly solution. GrowthBook's capabilities were reviewed, highlighting its flat pricing model, warehouse-native design for analytics, and integration features. The client is preparing for a follow-up in Q4, post their busy seasonal period, to delve deeper into the platform's integration and technical aspects.
calls.keywords: experiment platform, subscription pricing, feature flags, data warehouse native, Bayesian analysis, A/B testing
